title: Cyrus and the Witness
author: S. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Felix Montrose, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
